screen.design: Each of the eight seeds is replayed at all three equal-player paces. Pace blocks are repeated-measures robustness probes, not 24 fully independent seed observations.
screen.safety_cap_policy: Exceeding the safety cap is a harness failure and is not scored.

interpretation.purpose: Directional transfer screen only. Determine whether the legacy-arena tuned package shows a robust useful direction under the synchronous Tetrp authority before expensive confirmation or feature archaeology.
report: candidate/baseline KO wins separately at each pace

interpretation.no_pooled_significance: Do not compute a naive 24-match binomial p-value because each seed appears in three pace conditions.
interpretation.next_if_consistent_positive: Use fresh seeds for a larger new-authority confirmation, then decompose H1/H2/H6C/H9.
interpretation.next_if_mixed: Investigate pace interaction and state-model mismatch before feature ablation.
interpretation.next_if_negative: Do not resurrect the old lineage by inertia; use corrected legacy/new-authority evidence as the new starting point.
